rooms.name: Basement Parking
rooms.notes: Underground parking for 30 cars. Circular plan footprint (~706 sqm gross at 30m dia); net usable parking area accounts for ramps, drive aisles, and structural core. Provide natural ventilation via ramps or mechanical extraction per NBC Part 8 Sec 3. Seismic zone II detailing for RC retaining walls.

rooms.name: Electrical & MEP Utility Room
rooms.notes: Houses main LT panel, DB boards, UPS, MEP risers, and rainwater harvesting sump/pump room. Central-core-adjacent for easy riser routing. MEP routing required per brief.

rooms.name: Building Services Store
rooms.notes: General storage for FF&E, cleaning materials, and building maintenance equipment. Located adjacent to utility room for operational efficiency.

rooms.name: Loading Bay / Goods Entry
rooms.notes: Dedicated goods vehicle access and unloading dock for retail and office supplies. Direct ramp access from ground level. Separate from car parking circulation.

rooms.name: Basement Lobby / Lift Lobby
rooms.notes: Central core lift lobby at basement level connecting 2 lifts and 1 staircase to upper floors. Acts as transition node between parking and vertical circulation.

rooms.name: Basement Toilet / Sanitary Block
rooms.notes: Accessible toilet facilities for parking users and building staff. Includes 1 accessible WC per NBC Part 3 universal access norms. Locate away from loading bay.

response.floor_summary: Basement level (-1) serves as the underground parking podium for 30 cars, supported by MEP utility, rainwater harvesting infrastructure, building services store, goods loading bay, central lift lobby, and staff sanitary block — all within the 30 m diameter circular footprint.
